summary: News Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 17, 2026, reporting routine daily ASX disclosures tied to its previously authorized $1 billion stock repurchase program for Class A and Class B common stock. No new terms, price per share, premium, or board recommendation is included; the filing simply attaches two ASX information exhibits dated as noted therein. Because the company has a secondary ASX listing, it must disclose repurchase transactions daily. The filing signals continued execution of an existing buyback authorization, with no structural changes. Watch the pace of repurchases and remaining authorization as a modest signal of management's capital-return stance and potential support for the shares.
